phases.title: 1 · Identity & platform foundation
phases.deliverable: Workspace, identity, access boundaries and usable global patterns.

phases.title: 2 · Governed execution
phases.deliverable: Reviewed tools, durable execution and bounded admission.

phases.title: 3 · Knowledge & AI quality
phases.deliverable: Reviewed sources, retrieval, model controls and measured answer quality.

phases.title: 4 · Operational assurance
phases.deliverable: Cost controls, visibility, evidence and tested recovery.

phases.title: 5 · Deployment & acceptance
phases.deliverable: Controlled delivery and verified deployment acceptance.

journeys.title: Onboard an enterprise workspace
journeys.description: Connect organization, identity, membership, environment and access review.

journeys.title: Run a governed agent
journeys.description: Review a tool connection, register an agent, checkpoint execution and inspect evidence.

journeys.title: Turn a document into reviewed knowledge
journeys.description: Intake, review, apply access, retrieve evidence and evaluate quality.

journeys.title: Investigate and recover an incident
journeys.description: Follow alerts, investigation, controlled mitigation and evidence.

journeys.title: Review a production release
journeys.description: Inspect artifacts, scan findings, approval, rollout and rollback.

journeys.title: Control AI spend and capacity
journeys.description: Budget, admission, provider usage, reconciliation and evidence.

functions.title: REST adapter mapping
functions.runtime_note: An operator-configured NEXUS Business v1 HTTPS adapter is implemented. General protocol mapping, OAuth and customer sandbox acceptance remain open. Inspect Release readiness > Runtime signals.

functions.title: Idempotent dispatch review
functions.runtime_note: Reviewed destination binding, operation idempotency headers, bounded responses and authoritative lookup are implemented for the fixed HTTP contract. Customer-side deduplication must be accepted.

functions.title: Human checkpoint and escalation
functions.runtime_note: Independent checkpoint review with expiry is available. Automated escalation remains planned.

functions.title: Durable checkpoint storage
functions.runtime_note: Database-backed checkpoints and worker lease recovery are available for the bounded execution engine.

functions.title: Cancellation and compensation
functions.runtime_note: Pause/resume/cancel with a dispatch boundary is available. General compensation workflows remain planned.

functions.title: Document upload queue
functions.runtime_note: Persistent bounded PDF/DOCX/image intake with idempotent author-scoped recovery, worker leases and review before indexing is implemented. Direct UTF-8 intake remains available.

functions.title: Arabic and English OCR review
functions.runtime_note: Configured Tesseract OCR, explicit language selection and extracted-text review are implemented. English OCR is tested; Arabic requires operator-provisioned language data and quality acceptance.

functions.title: Duplicate and content-hash review
functions.runtime_note: Original SHA-256 provenance and idempotent request receipts are implemented. Semantic duplicate resolution is not implemented.

functions.title: Document lineage and versioning
functions.runtime_note: Original filename, byte count, SHA-256 and extraction method are linked to the published source/version. Existing version-checked replacements remain available; historical rollback and external lineage remain planned.

functions.title: Quarantine and parser failure
functions.runtime_note: Separate-process bounded extraction, stable failure codes, retry limits, cancellation fencing and review expiry are implemented. This is not malware scanning or a complete OS sandbox.

functions.title: Index publication approval
functions.runtime_note: Version-checked publication requires a review note and explicit source-comparison attestation. ACLs are applied before indexing. This is an authorized operator review, not a new independent approval policy.

functions.title: Hybrid retrieval weights
functions.runtime_note: Connected bounded local corpus-fitted LSA/BM25 search, ACL filtering and versioned source excerpts. Neural embedding, vector database, multilingual quality and production acceptance remain separate.

functions.title: Access-filtered retrieval
functions.runtime_note: Connected bounded local corpus-fitted LSA/BM25 search, ACL filtering and versioned source excerpts. Neural embedding, vector database, multilingual quality and production acceptance remain separate.

functions.title: Citation and provenance inspector
functions.runtime_note: Current version, chunk and source ACL verification is working for the text library. Vector/semantic provenance remains planned.

functions.title: Retrieval relevance benchmark
functions.runtime_note: Saved positive/no-result lexical retrieval checks measure document recall@k and reciprocal rank. Semantic retrieval and answer grading remain planned.

functions.title: Similarity threshold review
functions.runtime_note: Connected bounded local corpus-fitted LSA/BM25 search, ACL filtering and versioned source excerpts. Neural embedding, vector database, multilingual quality and production acceptance remain separate.

functions.title: Document RBAC matrix
functions.runtime_note: Author/admin management and explicit role/user read grants are available for the document library.

functions.title: Tenant isolation boundary
functions.runtime_note: Document retrieval filters the authenticated organization and current document ACL before ranking.

fields.label: Overflow policy
fields.default: Reject new work with retry guidance

functions.title: Session and device management
functions.runtime_note: Connected owner-only member provisioning, non-owner role/activation changes and session revocation. Session handles/expiry only; no device fingerprinting, SCIM/SAML, owner transfer or invitation delivery.

functions.title: Role and permission matrix
functions.runtime_note: Connected owner-only member provisioning, non-owner role/activation changes and session revocation. Session handles/expiry only; no device fingerprinting, SCIM/SAML, owner transfer or invitation delivery.

functions.title: Joiner mover leaver workflow
functions.runtime_note: Connected owner-only member provisioning, non-owner role/activation changes and session revocation. Session handles/expiry only; no device fingerprinting, SCIM/SAML, owner transfer or invitation delivery.

functions.title: Service metrics dashboard
functions.runtime_note: Current workspace database signals and optional protected Prometheus gauges are implemented. External alerts, distributed request telemetry and SLO drills remain open.

functions.title: Backup encryption references
functions.runtime_note: AES-256-GCM archive creation and isolated verification are implemented through the operator CLI. Key custody, encrypted temporary storage and retention remain operator controls.
